moduleTitle: Module 5. Renal, Digestive, Metabolic, Immune and Reproductive Physiology

competencies.name: Hypothalamic pituitary gonadal axis
competencies.can: Trace the gonadotropin releasing hormone axis to the gonads and place the feedback loops for both sexes.

competencies.name: Male reproductive physiology
competencies.can: Explain the control of spermatogenesis by follicle stimulating hormone, luteinizing hormone, and testosterone and state the roles of the Sertoli and Leydig cells.

competencies.name: Ovarian cycle
competencies.can: Order the follicular, ovulatory, and luteal phases and explain how the luteinizing hormone surge is triggered by positive feedback.

competencies.name: Uterine cycle
competencies.can: Correlate the menstrual, proliferative, and secretory phases of the uterine cycle with the estrogen and progesterone levels that drive them.

competencies.name: Pregnancy and placental hormones
competencies.can: Explain how human chorionic gonadotropin rescues the corpus luteum and state the roles of placental estrogen, progesterone, and relaxin.

competencies.name: Parturition and lactation
competencies.can: Explain labor as a positive feedback loop driven by oxytocin and compare the hormonal control of milk production with milk ejection.

competencies.name: Hormone cycle graph interpretation
competencies.can: Read a graph of gonadotropin and ovarian hormone levels across a cycle and identify the day of ovulation and the event driving each peak.
